12-Week Girls' Challenge
Meal Plan

Clean, simple, nourishing meals under 1,400 calories per day. Real food, real results, real flavor.

≤1,400 Cals / Day
12 Weeks
3 Phases
✦

How It Works

Your 3-phase roadmap to results

🌱
Phase 1 Reset (Weeks 1-4)

Clean out the noise. Focus on whole foods, high protein, lots of greens. Meals are simple and repetitive to build the habit.

~1,300Calories
120gProtein
HighVeggies
🔥
Phase 2 Burn (Weeks 5-8)

Introduce more variety and strategic carb timing. Fueling workouts while staying in a deficit. More flavor options added.

~1,350Calories
130gProtein
MedCarbs
💪
Phase 3 Finish Strong (Weeks 9-12)

Lean, clean, and locked in. Highest protein phase. Minimal starchy carbs at night. Preparing your body for the final reveal.

~1,250Calories
140gProtein
LowCarbs

🌿 Daily Non-Negotiables

Drink at least 80-100 oz of water every single day
Eat breakfast within 1 hour of waking up
Protein at every single meal, no exceptions
Vegetables at lunch AND dinner, always
Stop eating 2-3 hours before bed
Meal prep on Sundays to stay on track all week
💧

Hydration Goal: 100 oz dailyAdd lemon, cucumber, or fresh mint to your water to make it easier and more refreshing.

1

Weeks 1 & 2

Build the foundation. Keep it simple.

🔥
Daily Target
~1,300
🌅
Breakfast Egg White Spinach Toast
~340 cal
3 egg whites 1 cup spinach 1 slice sourdough 1 tbsp almond butter sea salt
✨ Flavor Boost

28gProtein
32gCarbs
8gFat
🥗
Lunch Grilled Chicken + Roasted Veggies
~380 cal
5 oz grilled chicken zucchini bell peppers broccoli olive oil spray

42gProtein
18gCarbs
9gFat
🍎
Snack Apple + Cottage Cheese
~180 cal
1 small apple ½ cup low-fat cottage cheese cinnamon
✨ Flavor Boost

🥩
Dinner Steak + Sweet Potato + Avo Wrap
~400 cal
4 oz sirloin steak ½ sweet potato 1 low-carb tortilla ¼ avocado arugula lime
✨ Flavor Boost

38gProtein
28gCarbs
14gFat

Meal prep your chicken and sweet potatoes on Sunday for the whole week.
If you're hungry between meals, drink 16 oz of water first and wait 10 minutes.
The first 3 days are the hardest. Push through and it gets easier.

2

Weeks 3 & 4

Introduce variety, keep the habit.

🔥
Daily Target
~1,320
🌅
Breakfast Greek Yogurt Power Bowl
~310 cal

✨ Flavor Boost

25gProtein
30gCarbs
9gFat
🌯

~360 cal
5 oz ground turkey butter lettuce cups cucumber cherry tomatoes shredded carrots lime
✨ Flavor Boost

38gProtein
14gCarbs
10gFat
🥚

~160 cal
2 hard boiled eggs 4 celery stalks 1 tbsp hummus everything bagel seasoning
✨ Flavor Boost
Sprinkle everything bagel seasoning on the hard boiled eggs and dip celery into hummus. Simple, filling, satisfying.
🍣
Dinner Baked Salmon + Asparagus + Cauliflower Rice
~390 cal
5 oz salmon fillet 1 cup asparagus 1 cup cauliflower rice lemon garlic olive oil
✨ Flavor Boost
Rub salmon with lemon zest, Dijon mustard, and fresh dill before baking at 400° for 12 min. Season cauliflower rice with coconut aminos and sesame oil. Add a drizzle of low-sodium soy sauce over everything. Restaurant worthy, zero effort.
40gProtein
16gCarbs
16gFat
Phase 2: Burn
3

Weeks 5 & 6

More variety. Fueling the fire.

🔥
Daily Target
~1,350
🌅
Breakfast Protein Oats with Berries
~360 cal
½ cup rolled oats 1 scoop vanilla protein powder ½ cup strawberries 1 tbsp almond butter almond milk
✨ Flavor Boost
Stir in 1 tsp of cocoa powder and a dash of espresso powder for a mocha oat situation. Top with sliced strawberries and a tiny sprinkle of flaky sea salt over the almond butter. Absolutely indulgent tasting, completely on plan.
32gProtein
38gCarbs
9gFat
🥗
Lunch Big Girl Salad with Tuna
~370 cal
1 can albacore tuna mixed greens cucumber artichoke hearts kalamata olives ½ cup chickpeas lemon vinaigrette
✨ Flavor Boost
Make a quick lemon vinaigrette: 1 tbsp olive oil + juice of ½ lemon + 1 tsp Dijon + garlic powder + salt. Shake in a jar and drizzle. Add capers on top for a briny punch that elevates the whole bowl.
40gProtein
22gCarbs
11gFat
🫐
Snack Protein Smoothie
~200 cal
1 scoop protein powder ½ frozen banana handful spinach almond milk ice
✨ Flavor Boost

🍗
Dinner Sheet Pan Chicken Thighs + Veggies
~420 cal
4 oz skinless chicken thigh Brussels sprouts red onion cherry tomatoes ½ cup brown rice herbs de Provence
✨ Flavor Boost
Marinate chicken in lemon, garlic, olive oil, and herbs de Provence for even 20 minutes before cooking. Roast everything on one pan at 425° for 25 min. Drizzle with balsamic glaze at the end. The Brussels sprouts get crispy and caramelized. Obsession worthy.
38gProtein
34gCarbs
13gFat

4

Weeks 7 & 8

Halfway there. Stay the course.

Daily Target
~1,350
🌅
Breakfast Veggie Egg Scramble + Fruit
~330 cal
2 whole eggs + 1 white mushrooms cherry tomatoes baby kale 1 clementine feta crumble
✨ Flavor Boost
Add a pinch of za'atar and a tiny crumble of feta at the very end so it melts just slightly. The salty, herby combo makes this feel completely indulgent. Serve with a clementine on the side for natural sweetness.
24gProtein
18gCarbs
12gFat
🌮
Lunch Clean Taco Bowl
~400 cal
4 oz ground turkey or beef ½ cup black beans romaine lettuce base pico de gallo ¼ avocado lime taco seasoning
✨ Flavor Boost
Make a clean chipotle cream: 2 tbsp Greek yogurt + ½ tsp chipotle powder + lime juice + salt. Drizzle over the bowl. Add fresh cilantro and a few pickled jalapeños. This beats Chipotle every single time.
38gProtein
28gCarbs
12gFat
🧀
Snack String Cheese + Bell Pepper Strips
~120 cal
2 mozzarella string cheese 1 bell pepper, sliced 1 tsp everything seasoning
✨ Flavor Boost
Use a mix of red, yellow, and orange bell peppers for the colors. Dip in a tiny bit of buffalo sauce if you need some heat. Easy, crunchy, satisfying.
🥩
Dinner Shrimp Stir Fry + Zucchini Noodles
~380 cal
5 oz shrimp 2 medium zucchini spiralized snap peas bok choy garlic coconut aminos sesame oil
✨ Flavor Boost
Make a 2-minute sauce: coconut aminos + fresh ginger + garlic + splash of rice vinegar + tiny drop sesame oil. Toss in at the end and cook 30 seconds. Top with sesame seeds and sliced green onions. This is a 10-minute dinner that slaps.
36gProtein
18gCarbs
10gFat
Phase 3: Finish Strong
5

Weeks 9 & 10

Leaner, cleaner, locked in.

🔥
Daily Target
~1,250
🌅
Breakfast Egg White + Veggie Muffin Cups
~280 cal
6 egg whites diced bell pepper spinach turkey sausage crumble 1 slice sourdough
✨ Flavor Boost
Bake egg white cups in a muffin tin on Sundays. Season with smoked paprika, garlic, and onion powder before baking. Reheat throughout the week. Serve with a slice of sourdough smeared with a thin layer of hummus instead of butter for an extra protein hit.
30gProtein
18gCarbs
4gFat
🥗
Lunch Grilled Chicken Cucumber Bowl
~360 cal
5 oz grilled chicken breast sliced cucumber cherry tomatoes red onion fresh mint 3 tbsp tzatziki
✨ Flavor Boost
Use store-bought tzatziki (check labels for low-fat) or make your own with Greek yogurt, cucumber, dill, lemon, and garlic. Season the chicken with lemon + oregano + garlic. This is a full Mediterranean bowl with zero guilt and maximum flavor.
44gProtein
14gCarbs
8gFat
🥑
Snack Avo Rice Cake
~150 cal
2 plain rice cakes ¼ avocado everything bagel seasoning red pepper flakes
✨ Flavor Boost
Mash the avo with lemon juice and a tiny pinch of salt. Spread generously, top with everything seasoning and red pepper flakes. You can also add a thin slice of smoked salmon on top for an extra protein boost and zero extra calories needed.
🥩
Dinner Lean Ground Beef Lettuce Tacos
~360 cal
4 oz 93/7 lean ground beef romaine or butter lettuce cups diced tomato shredded purple cabbage salsa verde lime cilantro
✨ Flavor Boost
Season beef with cumin, chili powder, oregano, garlic, and onion powder. Skip the tortilla and go full lettuce cups. The crunch of the cabbage and the acidity of the salsa verde makes this not feel like you're missing anything. Finish with fresh lime. Unreal.
36gProtein
10gCarbs
14gFat
Phase 3: Final Push
6

Weeks 11 & 12

The final push. You are almost there.

🔥
Daily Target
~1,200
🌅
Breakfast High Protein Overnight Oats
~320 cal
⅓ cup rolled oats ½ scoop vanilla protein ½ cup unsweetened almond milk 1 tsp chia seeds ¼ cup raspberries
✨ Flavor Boost
Mix the night before and refrigerate. In the morning stir in a tiny bit of vanilla extract and top with raspberries. You can add 1 tsp of cocoa powder for a chocolate raspberry flavor that tastes like a dessert and keeps you full for 4-5 hours. This is the meal prep queen breakfast.
22gProtein
32gCarbs
6gFat
🥗
Lunch Power Salmon Salad
~390 cal
4 oz canned or grilled salmon arugula + spinach mix shaved fennel grapefruit segments pepitas lemon olive oil dressing
✨ Flavor Boost
The grapefruit + salmon combo is a natural fat-burning pairing and it tastes absolutely stunning together. Dressing: 1 tsp olive oil + fresh lemon + 1 tsp honey + Dijon + salt. This salad tastes like something from a high-end spa menu.
38gProtein
16gCarbs
16gFat
🍵
Snack Matcha Protein Shake
~160 cal
1 tsp ceremonial matcha ½ scoop vanilla protein 1 cup oat milk ice dash of honey
✨ Flavor Boost
Blend everything cold with ice for an iced matcha latte meets protein shake. The matcha gives you clean energy without the coffee crash. Add a pinch of vanilla and a tiny drop of coconut extract for a tropical twist version.
🥩
Dinner Steak + Roasted Broccolini + Avo Tortilla
~400 cal
4 oz flank steak 1 bunch broccolini 1 low-carb tortilla ¼ avocado micro greens chimichurri
✨ Flavor Boost
Make a 30-second chimichurri: fresh parsley + garlic + red wine vinegar + olive oil + red pepper flakes. Spoon over sliced steak. Stuff into the tortilla with mashed avocado and micro greens. This is the kind of dinner you take a photo of. The perfect way to finish the challenge strong.
40gProtein
16gCarbs
18gFat

🏆 Final Stretch Reminders

You are in the home stretch. This is where most people quit. Don't be most people.
Take progress photos every Sunday morning. The visual proof keeps you motivated.
Salt is your friend for flavor but keep sodium in check if you're looking to minimize bloat in week 12.
Prioritize sleep. Recovery is where results are made.
Celebrate your wins loudly in the group. Everyone needs to hear it.
🎉
You did it, girl.
12 weeks. Every meal. Every rep. Every moment you chose yourself over comfort. That is the real transformation.
The Luxora Collective theluxoracollective.co · Built for the girls who are serious about showing up.

This includes reading or extracting text/tables from PDFs, combining or merging multiple PDFs into one, splitting PDFs apart, rotating pages, adding watermarks, creating new PDFs, filling PDF forms, encrypting/decrypting PDFs, extracting images, and OCR on scanned PDFs to make them searchable. If the user mentions a .pdf file or asks to produce one, use this skill.

     5	---
     6	
     7	# PDF Processing Guide
     8	
     9	## Overview
    10	
    11	This guide covers essential PDF processing operations using Python libraries and command-line tools. For advanced features, JavaScript libraries, and detailed examples, see REFERENCE.md. If you need to fill out a PDF form, read FORMS.md and follow its instructions.
    12	
    13	## Quick Start
    14	
    15	```python
    16	from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
    17	
    18	# Read a PDF
    19	reader = PdfReader("document.pdf")
    20	print(f"Pages: {len(reader.pages)}")
    21	
    22	# Extract text
    23	text = ""
    24	for page in reader.pages:
    25	    text += page.extract_text()
    26	```
    27	
    28	## Python Libraries
    29	
    30	### pypdf - Basic Operations
    31	
    32	#### Merge PDFs
    33	```python
    34	from pypdf import PdfWriter, PdfReader
    35	
    36	writer = PdfWriter()
    37	for pdf_file in ["doc1.pdf", "doc2.pdf", "doc3.pdf"]:
    38	    reader = PdfReader(pdf_file)
    39	    for page in reader.pages:
    40	        writer.add_page(page)
    41	
    42	with open("merged.pdf", "wb") as output:
    43	    writer.write(output)
    44	```
    45	
    46	#### Split PDF
    47	```python
    48	reader = PdfReader("input.pdf")
    49	for i, page in enumerate(reader.pages):
    50	    writer = PdfWriter()
    51	    writer.add_page(page)
    52	    with open(f"page_{i+1}.pdf", "wb") as output:
    53	        writer.write(output)
    54	```
    55	
    56	#### Extract Metadata
    57	```python
    58	reader = PdfReader("document.pdf")
    59	meta = reader.metadata
    60	print(f"Title: {meta.title}")
    61	print(f"Author: {meta.author}")
    62	print(f"Subject: {meta.subject}")
    63	print(f"Creator: {meta.creator}")
    64	```
    65	
    66	#### Rotate Pages
    67	```python
    68	reader = PdfReader("input.pdf")
    69	writer = PdfWriter()
    70	
    71	page = reader.pages[0]
    72	page.rotate(90)  # Rotate 90 degrees clockwise
    73	writer.add_page(page)
    74	
    75	with open("rotated.pdf", "wb") as output:
    76	    writer.write(output)
    77	```
    78	
    79	### pdfplumber - Text and Table Extraction
    80	
    81	#### Extract Text with Layout
    82	```python
    83	import pdfplumber
    84	
    85	with pdfplumber.open("document.pdf") as pdf:
    86	    for page in pdf.pages:
    87	        text = page.extract_text()
    88	        print(text)
    89	```
    90	
    91	#### Extract Tables
    92	```python
    93	with pdfplumber.open("document.pdf") as pdf:
    94	    for i, page in enumerate(pdf.pages):
    95	        tables = page.extract_tables()
    96	        for j, table in enumerate(tables):
    97	            print(f"Table {j+1} on page {i+1}:")
    98	            for row in table:
    99	                print(row)
   100	```
   101	
   102	#### Advanced Table Extraction
   103	```python
   104	import pandas as pd
   105	
   106	with pdfplumber.open("document.pdf") as pdf:
   107	    all_tables = []
   108	    for page in pdf.pages:
   109	        tables = page.extract_tables()
   110	        for table in tables:
   111	            if table:  # Check if table is not empty
   112	                df = pd.DataFrame(table[1:], columns=table[0])
   113	                all_tables.append(df)
   114	
   115	# Combine all tables
   116	if all_tables:
   117	    combined_df = pd.concat(all_tables, ignore_index=True)
   118	    combined_df.to_excel("extracted_tables.xlsx", index=False)
   119	```
   120	
   121	### reportlab - Create PDFs
   122	
   123	#### Basic PDF Creation
   124	```python
   125	from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
   126	from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas
   127	
   128	c = canvas.Canvas("hello.pdf", pagesize=letter)
   129	width, height = letter
   130	
   131	# Add text
   132	c.drawString(100, height - 100, "Hello World!")
   133	c.drawString(100, height - 120, "This is a PDF created with reportlab")
   134	
   135	# Add a line
   136	c.line(100, height - 140, 400, height - 140)
   137	
   138	# Save
   139	c.save()
   140	```
   141	
   142	#### Create PDF with Multiple Pages
   143	```python
   144	from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
   145	from reportlab.platypus import SimpleDocTemplate, Paragraph, Spacer, PageBreak
   146	from reportlab.lib.styles import getSampleStyleSheet
   147	
   148	doc = SimpleDocTemplate("report.pdf", pagesize=letter)
   149	styles = getSampleStyleSheet()
   150	story = []
   151	
   152	# Add content
   153	title = Paragraph("Report Title", styles['Title'])
   154	story.append(title)
   155	story.append(Spacer(1, 12))
   156	
   157	body = Paragraph("This is the body of the report. " * 20, styles['Normal'])
   158	story.append(body)
   159	story.append(PageBreak())
   160	
   161	# Page 2
   162	story.append(Paragraph("Page 2", styles['Heading1']))
   163	story.append(Paragraph("Content for page 2", styles['Normal']))
   164	
   165	# Build PDF
   166	doc.build(story)
   167	```
   168	
   169	#### Subscripts and Superscripts
   170	
   171	**IMPORTANT**: Never use Unicode subscript/superscript characters (₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉, ⁰¹²³⁴⁵⁶⁷⁸⁹) in ReportLab PDFs. The built-in fonts do not include these glyphs, causing them to render as solid black boxes.
   172	
   173	Instead, use ReportLab's XML markup tags in Paragraph objects:
   174	```python
   175	from reportlab.platypus import Paragraph
   176	from reportlab.lib.styles import getSampleStyleSheet
   177	
   178	styles = getSampleStyleSheet()
   179	
   180	# Subscripts: use <sub> tag
   181	chemical = Paragraph("H<sub>2</sub>O", styles['Normal'])
   182	
   183	# Superscripts: use <super> tag
   184	squared = Paragraph("x<super>2</super> + y<super>2</super>", styles['Normal'])
   185	```
   186	
   187	For canvas-drawn text (not Paragraph objects), manually adjust font the size and position rather than using Unicode subscripts/superscripts.
   188	
   189	## Command-Line Tools
   190	
   191	### pdftotext (poppler-utils)
   192	```bash
   193	# Extract text
   194	pdftotext input.pdf output.txt
   195	
   196	# Extract text preserving layout
   197	pdftotext -layout input.pdf output.txt
   198	
   199	# Extract specific pages
   200	pdftotext -f 1 -l 5 input.pdf output.txt  # Pages 1-5
   201	```
   202	
   203	### qpdf
   204	```bash
   205	# Merge PDFs
   206	qpdf --empty --pages file1.pdf file2.pdf -- merged.pdf
   207	
   208	# Split pages
   209	qpdf input.pdf --pages . 1-5 -- pages1-5.pdf
   210	qpdf input.pdf --pages . 6-10 -- pages6-10.pdf
   211	
   212	# Rotate pages
   213	qpdf input.pdf output.pdf --rotate=+90:1  # Rotate page 1 by 90 degrees
   214	
   215	# Remove password
   216	qpdf --password=mypassword --decrypt encrypted.pdf decrypted.pdf
   217	```
   218	
   219	### pdftk (if available)
   220	```bash
   221	# Merge
   222	pdftk file1.pdf file2.pdf cat output merged.pdf
   223	
   224	# Split
   225	pdftk input.pdf burst
   226	
   227	# Rotate
   228	pdftk input.pdf rotate 1east output rotated.pdf
   229	```
   230	
   231	## Common Tasks
   232	
   233	### Extract Text from Scanned PDFs
   234	```python
   235	# Requires: pip install pytesseract pdf2image
   236	import pytesseract
   237	from pdf2image import convert_from_path
   238	
   239	# Convert PDF to images
   240	images = convert_from_path('scanned.pdf')
   241	
   242	# OCR each page
   243	text = ""
   244	for i, image in enumerate(images):
   245	    text += f"Page {i+1}:\n"
   246	    text += pytesseract.image_to_string(image)
   247	    text += "\n\n"
   248	
   249	print(text)
   250	```
   251	
   252	### Add Watermark
   253	```python
   254	from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
   255	
   256	# Create watermark (or load existing)
   257	watermark = PdfReader("watermark.pdf").pages[0]
   258	
   259	# Apply to all pages
   260	reader = PdfReader("document.pdf")
   261	writer = PdfWriter()
   262	
   263	for page in reader.pages:
   264	    page.merge_page(watermark)
   265	    writer.add_page(page)
   266	
   267	with open("watermarked.pdf", "wb") as output:
   268	    writer.write(output)
   269	```
   270	
   271	### Extract Images
   272	```bash
   273	# Using pdfimages (poppler-utils)
   274	pdfimages -j input.pdf output_prefix
   275	
   276	# This extracts all images as output_prefix-000.jpg, output_prefix-001.jpg, etc.
   277	```
   278	
   279	### Password Protection
   280	```python
   281	from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
   282	
   283	reader = PdfReader("input.pdf")
   284	writer = PdfWriter()
   285	
   286	for page in reader.pages:
   287	    writer.add_page(page)
   288	
   289	# Add password
   290	writer.encrypt("userpassword", "ownerpassword")
   291	
   292	with open("encrypted.pdf", "wb") as output:
   293	    writer.write(output)
   294	```
   295	
   296	## Quick Reference
   297	
   298	| Task | Best Tool | Command/Code |
   299	|------|-----------|--------------|
   300	| Merge PDFs | pypdf | `writer.add_page(page)` |
   301	| Split PDFs | pypdf | One page per file |
